name: Viscer Nursing I
summary:
VisceR Nursing I is an immersive VR clinical training experience designed for nursing students and healthcare learners. It enables learners to practice essential clinical skills and procedures in a safe, repeatable, risk-free virtual environment.

The pack covers three key areas:

GENERAL MEDICINE
• Capillary Blood Glucose
• Blood Transfusion
• Oxygen Therapy
• Venipuncture
• Peripheral Blood

WOUND CARE & BANDAGING
• Basic Wound Care
• Ulcer Dressing
• Compression Bandage

DERMATOLOGY
• KOH Examination
• K
